correct_completion: I would have finished the report yesterday.
full_sentence: If I were more organised, I would have finished the report yesterday.
acceptable_variants: I would have completed it before the deadline.
I would have sent it to my boss yesterday.

options.text: I will finish the report tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: A future form does not give the past result that a mixed conditional needs, because the sentence refers to yesterday.

options.text: I would have finished the report yesterday.
so I finished it on time.
options.why_wrong: 'So' shows a real cause and effect, but the sentence needs an imagined past result after the unreal present condition.
This describes a past fact, not the imagined result that the 'if' clause introduces.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals (unreal present condition, unreal past result)
explanation: A mixed conditional uses a past simple in the 'if' clause to talk about an unreal present, and would have plus a past participle in the main clause to talk about an unreal past result. Polish speakers often use a simple past form in the result clause because Polish marks conditionals with a particle, so the English would have structure needs practice.
translation: Gdybym był bardziej zorganizowany, skończyłbym raport już wczoraj.
